name: Race For Nuts
storyline:
In a galaxy far, far away, on a small planet, there lived a happy squirrel people. They played and had fun all day long, enjoying life.

Until one day, a squirrel-astronomer, who looked at the stars every night from his telescope in the tallest pine tree, made a terrible discovery. He saw that a huge meteorite was approaching the planet of squirrels. All night long, he calculated the trajectories and speeds of the home planet and the approaching meteorite.

In the morning, he made a sensational announcement for the entire tribe: "very soon the entire planet will perish from a collision with a meteorite!" The tribe was seized by panic! The squirrels rushed around the forest, not knowing what to do now and how to save themselves!

And then the squirrels ran to their elder - the wisest hundred-year-old squirrel, and asked what they should do now.

And the elder decided to create a council and invited shamans from all the squirrel tribes from all over the planet to it. The council decided to send scouts to the human city to find out how people would save themselves from the coming cataclysm. One of the scouts was lucky. He managed to find out that people had already started building a huge spaceship, on which they wanted to fly away from their home planet.

After the general council, the elder gathered the entire tribe and announced that all squirrels would escape from the planet on a human ship. However, the flight could be very long and all squirrels need to stock up on nuts.

You are a squirrel from the tribe and your mission is to collect as many nuts as possible, moving with your squad to different corners of the squirrel planet. The task of the Shaman is to help other squirrels collect as many nuts as possible.
summary:
Save your squirrel tribe from the impending disaster and help other squirrels to escape!
High mountains and icy valleys, hot deserts and bottomless pits await you!
You will find new friends and enemies. The world of the Race For Nuts is waiting for you!
